eventDetail.scope: Welcome to ICBIM 2026, the 10th International Conference on Business and Information Management. Hosted by Rajamangala University of Technology Tawan-ok, it will be held November 20–22, 2026, at its Chakrabongse Bhuvanarth Campus in Bangkok, Thailand. This international forum gathers researchers, academics, industry practitioners and policy leaders to exchange ideas, present latest findings and promote interdisciplinary collaboration in business, information systems and digital technologies. Amid digital transformation, AI, machine learning, big data, cloud computing, blockchain and intelligent IoT are reshaping organizational operations. Focused on “From Digital to Value: Empowering Business Management via AI & Data Integration”, the conference covers AI systems, data analytics, digital platforms and AI-driven industrial transformation. Its program includes keynotes, paper presentations, panels and networking.
